correctness.rationale: A direct expansion of P^r and Parseval reduces the 2r moment to equal-frequency ordered pairs. Since gcd(A,B)=1 the integer kernel is generated by (-(B-A),B,-A); positive and negative masses each equal |t|B. Every collision pair has the unique residual parameterization, yielding precisely C_{r,A,B}(t), D_r, and ±t phase exponents. At r=B the only nonzero coefficient is binom(B,A), and binomial monotonicity for A<=B/2 proves inverse recovery. Independent exact convolution counting matched 869 (r,A,B) cases through r=11, B=16, plus reflected binomial injectivity through B=120; none substitutes for the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: Original review: first phase-sensitive moment and response width determine the reduced outer gap B and interior gap A modulo reflection.

This is a natural inverse invariant for phase observability of a three-frequency spectrum. The first observable even moment equals the reduced support diameter B and its exact response amplitude 2 binom(B,A) determines the other gap up to reflection. The full polynomial describes all higher even-moment phase harmonics; no non-even moments or higher-harmonic minimizers are claimed. The result is a narrow structural observation, not a broad new majorant theorem.
